summary: This joint resolution expresses support for designating the week of February 3-7, 2025, as "National School Counseling Week" to recognize the contributions of school counselors and encourage public awareness of their role in student success.

scores.thoughts: This bill is a joint resolution to designate 'National School Counseling Week' and recognizes the contributions of school counselors. While it highlights the importance of school counselors and notes that counseling positions are not always protected when local budgets are cut, it does not propose any spending changes or policy shifts regarding public school funding. Its focus is purely on recognition and awareness.
